WITH gf AS (

x AS (

SELECT x.reason_code, count(*) n, sum(x.quantity_returned) units,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL) orphan,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.quantity_returned > f.quantity) over_qty,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sale_date > x.return_date) before_sale,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.product_key <> x.product_key) prod_mismatch,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) multi_returned,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) staff
FROM x LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=x.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999
